payout_quote: You will immediately receive 250 bonus points upon registering for earnify, which gets you an immediate ampm reward or a discount on fuel. Burn: 200 points = $2 in convenience savings OR an additional 5 cent per gallon discount.
steps: Download the free earnify app (iOS/Android) and finish registration with a unique phone number
250 bonus points land immediately in the earnify wallet
Redeem in the app (Rewards, Redeem points): 200 points = $2 in convenience-store savings or a 5-cent-per-gallon discount; scan wallet at register or enter phone number at pump
catches: 250 welcome points cover ONE 200-point redemption ($2) - the remaining 50 points stay in the wallet toward the next redemption
bp/Amoco/ampm/Thorntons fuel and store savings only - not cash
Only at participating earnify stations and locations
Points expire after 90 days of no interaction with earnify
Double-points on transactions for the first 90 days is ongoing earning, not the signup bonus
biggest_catch: About $2 of bp-only savings - trivial unless you already fuel at bp, Amoco, ampm, or Thorntons.
eligibility: New earnify registrant; smartphone with a unique phone number
